title: pq-obfs in lyrebird: code, data and analysis for "Migrating a Deployed Censorship-Circumvention Transport to Post-Quantum Key Exchange"
description:
Research artifact for the paper Migrating a Deployed Censorship-Circumvention Transport to Post-Quantum Key Exchange: Wire-Image Leakage, Defenses, and Conformance Testing in Tor's obfs4 (Ban AlOmar and Zouheir Trabelsi, submitted to the Journal of Information Security and Applications).

Contents: a branch of Tor's lyrebird with the pq-obfs transport (Kemeleon-encoded ML-KEM-768, rejection and default encodings, X25519 hybrid, key rotation, key-identifier bridge lines) and the coordinated-cover options for obfs4 and pq-obfs (response-time normalization, obfs4 padding floor); the measurement harness and analysis scripts; a draft pq-obfs specification; Kemeleon decoding test vectors and a conformance tool; the Drivel evaluation harness; reports for the three upstream defects; and the result files and packet captures behind every table and figure. The artifact README maps each table and figure to the script and result file that produce it.
